notes.title: I Added a Skill Tree with insane Powers
notes.notes:
[p][b]🔥 New Devlog Out Now![/b]
Hey adventurers![/p][p]In this update, I’m showcasing the newly implemented [b]Skill Tree System[/b] where you can unlock and equip [b]5 unique ultimate abilities[/b], from lightning storms to soul chains. Each skill is designed to drastically change the way you approach combat, and yes… some of them might be a little overpowered 😅.[/p][p]⚔️ [b]Crush Wave[/b] – sweep enemies in a straight line
 🪨 [b]Mountain Seal[/b] – smash with a spinning boulder
⚡ [b]Charge Attack[/b] – dash to nearby enemies
🕸️ [b]Cursed Chains[/b] – rip enemy souls
🌩️ [b]Holy Hand[/b] – full-screen lightning devastation[/p][p]You’ll also get a peek into the in-game [b]library[/b] where skills are unlocked  open only from [b]10 AM to 6 PM[/b] in-game time.[/p][p]🎥 [b]Watch the full devlog video to see the skills in action![/b][/p][p]If you enjoy the progress, don’t forget to [b]wishlist Swordborn[/b] on Steam and leave your feedback it really helps!

Link : [dynamiclink href="https://youtu.be/fqk2Jd0C8oM"][/dynamiclink][/p]
